svg.title: Toolbox: 73 tools in six groups
svg.desc: 73 tools. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, HTML5, CSS. Front-end: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, Zustand, TanStack Query, Recharts, Vite, React Router, Vue.js, Bootstrap, Vue Router, Lucide, React Icons, next-intl, next-themes, jsPDF. Back-end: Node.js, Express, Hono, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, Auth.js, Zod, Google Identity Services, aws4fetch, Resend, JWT, bcrypt, Supabase Auth, Midtrans, API.co.id, React Email, Tesseract.js. Databases and infra: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Supabase, Vercel, Cloudflare R2, Hostinger, Netlify, Docker. Machine learning: TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, Streamlit, Jupyter, Hugging Face, NLTK, Sastrawi. Testing and tooling: Git, GitHub, Playwright, ESLint, Biome, Postman, Figma, Claude Code, Codex, Vitest, GitHub Actions.
